project_overview.description: A scroll-driven cinematic organism, one continuous morphing composition. Not a traditional webpage. Elements physically transform into the next scene. No standard webpage sections.

visual_enhancers.grain: SVG noise overlay with mix-blend-mode or CSS background grain fixed over the viewport
visual_enhancers.light_fields: Subtle radial gradients that follow cursor or drift slowly in the background
visual_enhancers.masks: Clip-path masks using SVG or CSS to reveal layers (e.g., typography as mask)

restrictions: Pure kinetic typography, grain, and light fields

motion_system_4_layers.L1_global_atmosphere: Subtle drift, tonal evolution, persistent grain, independent of scroll.
motion_system_4_layers.L2_scroll_response: Calm on slow scroll, energetic/skewed on fast scroll, settle with inertia on stop, direction-aware reversing.
motion_system_4_layers.L3_scene_transformation: Size, orientation, clipping, hierarchy, density physically shift to form the next state (cross-scene morphing).
motion_system_4_layers.L4_cursor_interaction: Typography displacement (repel/attract), magnetic elements, contextual cursor labels.

01_restrained_opening.description: Tiny KYMR dot/text. Visitor wonders 'what is this?'. Silence, tension.
01_restrained_opening.morphing_to_next: Metamorphosis: breathing dot -> hairline -> aperture frame -> KYMR identity.

02_first_big_wow.description: Small type expands beyond viewport. Impact, explosive expansion.
02_first_big_wow.morphing_to_next: Letters become framing elements, negative space reveals next layer via clip-path window.

03_visual_statements.description: WE MAKE THINGS PEOPLE WATCH. Kinetic, aggressive.
03_visual_statements.morphing_to_next: Words separate/collide/rotate/stretch/become masks for the next scene.

04_process_installation.description: 4 visually distinct morphing states. Rhythmic, mechanical, hypnotic.
04_process_installation.morphing_to_next: The 10+ echoes collapse into single points that become the incoming 'Forces'.

05_capabilities_as_forces.description: STRATEGY enters, CREATIVE pushes it aside, PRODUCTION reorganizes, EDITING cuts through the typography, PERFORMANCE takes over the viewport. Chaotic, structural reorganization.
05_capabilities_as_forces.morphing_to_next: Performance text slices and dissipates into extreme minimalism.

06_the_void.description: Extreme minimalism, tiny type, expanding element. Silence, unsettling quiet.
06_the_void.morphing_to_next: A single element slowly expands endlessly as user scrolls.

07_major_takeover.description: Small element consumes viewport and beyond. Overwhelming, massive shift.
07_major_takeover.morphing_to_next: Interface physically changes scale and INVERTS the world (dark -> bone tonal flip).

08_future_work.description: Empty unwritten frame outlines as anti-portfolio statement ('THE ARCHIVE IS JUST BEGINNING' / 'THE NEXT FRAME IS YOURS'). Reflective, conceptual.
08_future_work.morphing_to_next: Frames collapse and condense into typography.

09_film_finale.description: Density collapses, typography enormous, KYMR as final identity, simple mailto. Finality, bold grounding.

ten_holy_shit_moments: 1. typography-as-mask: Letter counter becomes a clip-path window (Scene 02)
2. beyond-viewport expansion: KYMR letters scale beyond screen limits (Scene 02)
4. pinned composition change: Visual statements colliding and reforming (Scene 03)
5. horizontal-from-vertical: Capabilities forces pushing aside vertically (Scene 05)
6. unexpected direction change: EDITING slice-cut through typography (Scene 05)
7. density collapse into emptiness: Performance dissipates into the Void (Scene 06)
8. tiny-to-fullscreen: The Void expanding element into Major Takeover (Scene 07)
9. cinematic resolution: Tonal flip (dark to bone) and density collapse into finale (Scene 07-09)
10. navigation transforming: Morphing navigation state indicator responsive to scroll velocity

cursor_interaction_spec.text_hover: Typography displacement (subtly repelled by cursor presence).
cursor_interaction_spec.magnetic: Interactive elements snap to cursor slightly.
cursor_interaction_spec.contextual: Cursor expands and displays labels based on section (e.g., 'SCROLL', 'DISCOVER', 'CONTACT').

seeded_variation_spec.description: Use a daily seed (e.g., deterministic hash of current Date) to alter animation timings, initial rotations, or typography displacement strength slightly. Ensures the site feels alive and different each visit but maintains coherence.

depth_layer_spec.foreground: Cursor, dynamic navigation indicator, persistent grain overlay, sharp high-contrast kinetic typography.
depth_layer_spec.middleground: Main transforming elements, typographic masks, colliding forces.
depth_layer_spec.background: Atmospheric light fields, echoing typography, subtle drift.

mobile_reinterpretation.description: Intentional lighter interpretation for performance. Reduce heavy DOM manipulation. Focus on transform-only animations (translate, scale). Scale back typography displacement calculation. Keep the core scene transitions (scale, clip-path) but simplify colliding forces and multi-layered masking.

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT OVERDESIGN. Embrace negative space, fewer elements with better art direction.
Do NOT think in traditional webpage sections (<section> stacked vertically). Build a single pinned <main> container with overlapping absolute elements driven by GSAP ScrollTrigger timeline.
Ensure all animations use transforms (`translate`, `scale`, `rotate`) and `opacity` for hardware acceleration and performance.
Implement `prefers-reduced-motion` media queries to simplify or disable intense animations.
Use GSAP Flip plugin or seamless timeline cross-fades/transforms for continuous state morphing.
Maintain the contact form and admin vault as they already exist. Do not break existing backend routing.
Create React components (.js/.jsx) reflecting VISUAL STATES rather than typical pages.
Never use transparent backgrounds behind content where readability is lost without a backdrop filter/blur.
Ensure Lenis is configured for buttery smooth scroll with appropriate easing.
No placeholder images, no UI cards. Only Typography, Space, Lines, and Motion.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and blending modes.
Do not apply universal transitions (`transition: all`), add transitions for specific properties.
Never use AI assistant emoji characters for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use generous spacing (2x-3x normal). Cramped designs look cheap.
Do not apply global text-align center.
